description: Deterministically resolve a folder and enable or disable offline (mobile app) playback for every CONVERTED video inside it, in one batch call (POST /app). dry_run=true (default) previews the affected videos.

enabled.description: true = allow offline playback, false = disable

expire_days.description: Days until offline access expires (null = never)

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

name: panda_action_set_folder_videos_offline
title: Set Folder Videos Offline Playback
